title: NJ State Ethics Commission — James Fox — Decision — Dismissal (No. 038-14)
text:
IN THE MATTER OF STATE ETHICS COMMISSION
JAMES FOX, MEMBER,
LOCAL FINANCE BOARD,
DEPARTMENT OF
COMMUNITY AFFAIRS Commission Case No. 38-14
DECISION
the Local Finance Board
This matter arises from an allegation that James Fox, member of
("LFB"), violated the Conflcts of Interest Law by failing to recuse on two matters before the
LFB relating to Matthew Doherty.
After considering the results of an investigation into the allegations against James Fox,
the Commission dismissed the matter pursuant to NJA.C. 19:61-3.1(g).
DECISION RENDERED BY THE
STATE ETHICS COMMISSION ON
THE 16th DAY OF SEPTEMBER, 2014
